flags.message: The provisioned 16-page application is present but has empty_text=true and ocr_derived=false; application.txt is whitespace only. The forecast uses the snapshot and prior-Term interim base rate without access to the application's arguments or underlying decisions. OCR would materially improve the evidence base.

Arrival chronology is inconsistent: the event/submission date is 2026-10-10 and snapshot/context boundary is 2026-10-11, but the snapshot header says docketed October 19, 2026, and the document URL identifies an October 19 upload. The October 22 fetch is later still. No disposition was exposed. I preserved the frozen arrival state and did not infer later proceedings from this metadata.
